issues.what: Umayyad keyframes 692, 693, 694-697 and 698-700 draw the whole of Algeria (Tell, Aures, Altava's Oranais, Saharan oases; about 2,900 cells) as caliphate land before Carthage (698), the Kahina (c. 701) and Altava (708); the keyframe snap also took Altava's whole Oranais under R2. Algeria cut from the four keyframes; the ledger's own later gains stand.

Libya: the stale Byzantine keyframes of 656 and 666 take back Cyrenaica (381 cells in 656-660) and Tripolitania (163 cells in 666) that Barqa and Tripoli's conquest of 642-643 and Uqba's of 662-663 had given the caliphate.

Tang keyframes 633, 638 and 641 draw 1,278 cells of Chita and Buryatia (Transbaikal) as direct Tang land 14 years before the Yanran protectorate; from 647 to 681 the same cells stay direct Tang land beside the vassal-tint plateau. Cut from 633-646; put under the Yanran vassal tint 647-681.

Egypt ownerless 617-622 (2,008 cells; 12,000 cell-years): the eastern-roman-empire 617 keyframe subtracts Egypt although its own text keeps Egypt Roman until June 619. Egypt restored in the keyframe so the ledger moves it (Alexandria 619, the rest 621).

Sichuan, Chongqing and Hanzhong (1,443 cells) brought over by Li Xiaogong in the dossier's own 618 gain event are snapped away again by the 618-622 Tang keyframe (Guanzhong and Shanxi only) and stay ownerless until the 623 snap.

baekje-restoration-movement: the gazetteer lacks 'Seocheon', so ledger/1, ledger/2, the 662 keyframe and the successor land are skipped; the movement kept the whole Baekje core to 663 and the land was then ownerless to 671 (about 1,400 cell-years). Juryu proxied by Gunsan 30 km (across the Geum estuary from Seocheon); the land beyond Juryu goes to the Ungjin Commandery in 662 and Juryu in October 663.
The 645 vassal_end of the Ashina buffer state hands its whole vassal land (4,431 cells of Inner Mongolia) to nobody until the Tang keyframe of 647; the infobox has 'Reconquest by Tang dynasty: 645'.

Swabia (241 cells) ownerless from 644 to the end of the window: the Frankish ledger/24 loses it to 'frisia-kingdom', a Cliopatria label with no dossier. Given to the Duchy of Alamannia, which broke from the Franks after Dagobert I's death (638).

eastern-gokturks / yenisei-kyrgyz: Tuva (438 cells, 2,628 cell-years) goes to the Kyrgyz by the size rule. The page has the Turks 'controlled the Yenisei Kyrgyz' under Muqan (553-572) and is silent for 612-628, so the Kyrgyz holding their homeland as Turkic subjects is a fair drawing.

karkota-dynasty / western-gokturks (Northern Areas, Pakistan; 1,116 cell-years) and tibetan-empire / western-gokturks in Xinjiang 628-634 (562 cell-years): the dossiers call their own claims Cliopatria's with the pages silent; no page opened.

Ownerless land the dossiers bridge on purpose and the pages do not date: the Mongolian Plateau 682-691 (6,160 cells), Inner Mongolia south of the Gobi 692-699 (2,017 cells), the Kazakh steppe from 657 (3,890 cells), the Gangetic plain after Harsha 647, the Avar steppe from 656, Samo's land from 658, and the Exarchate's Algerian coast (436 cells) after 698 now that the Umayyad keyframe no longer covers it.

Tang 623 keyframe still adds 2,143 cells (about 500 north Shaanxi, 300 Gansu, 170 Ningxia, 100 Inner Mongolia and the south of 626) with no dated event; the dossier already says no page gives a date or boundary. The Tang 618 keyframe also still removes 392 cells (Xue Ju's Qin in Gansu, gained in December 618 by the ledger).
